text:
QUOTE: "Any `char*` return transfers ownership to the caller. It must be released with `entropic_free()`, and never with the host `free()`." and "Strings returned as `const char*` (e.g. `entropic_version`) are static or engine-owned. Do not free them."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The char* ownership and entropic_free rule is stated, but the const char* case is described as static or engine-owned with no statement that it is only valid until the next call on the handle.
